name: ai.tenprint/tenprint
title: Tenprint
description: Post-quantum AI compliance attestation. Free local tier; API key anchors to Hedera.

environmentVariables.name: TENPRINT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for Hedera anchoring. Optional; omit for the free local tier. RUBRIC_API_KEY still works as a deprecated fallback.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key for x402 paid tools (USDC on Base). Omit to receive setup guidance instead of a charge.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_MCP_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool modules to expose. Default is core,x402. Use all for every module.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key. Required for tools/call. initialize and tools/list work without it.
